changes.reason: Normal local execution of tools/video/core/metadata.mjs withStoryTag(title,"en") produces "Seiko: Why did a ¥450,000 watch still need factory adjustment? | Brand Stories｜Brand Story". The plural existing suffix is not recognized by STORY_TAIL, so the displayed title repeats the series name. Use the exact STORY_TAGS.en single suffix; this preserves the title meaning.
